test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Four different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one having '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15dd71daeea3eb8055745864294bb7f2d84118c6ba7be214e69ef3ba9574eebd.png]
solution:
Given:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15dd71daeea3eb8055745864294bb7f2d84118c6ba7be214e69ef3ba9574eebd.png] 

Rotate the third and fourth positions in a clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6f49830ad1e2010f3bba68a6c353fcd0e2415b5e1c15b6af4af2f864c13c358.png] 

We get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6454f444fc522f82f27591bd1560ff6db4f9f171bd4a81ebf8dcbe7dde6d845.png] 

In the above positions, number '3' is common.

Thus, we get

 
 

 
 
**Number**

 
 
 
**Opposite**

 
 
 

 
 
1

 
 
 
2

 
 
 

 
 
6

 
 
 
4

 
 
 

Hence, the face opposite to 1 is **“2”.**

Hence, the correct answer is **“2”**
